headline: City Economists Lower Bank of England Peak Interest Rate Projections
summary: City of London economists assess that the Bank of England is unlikely to raise interest rates to 4.75% by next summer, with some forecasting monetary easing by the end of 2027.
why: The Bank of England sets the monetary policy stance for the United Kingdom. Benchmark rates dictate mortgage financing, consumer credit borrowing costs, and corporate debt valuations across sterling markets.

impacts.name: UK Gilts
impacts.why: Diminished expectations of terminal rate increases support prices for British sovereign bonds.
